identification: Demi-lune (half-round) timber console/hall table, stained mahogany or similar hardwood, plain top with low upstand along the straight back edge, three square tapered legs (two front, one centre back) with small block/castor-type feet. Probably early-mid 20th century, no maker. H81 L167 D50 cm. Very long and plain; top shows wear.

viewing_check: Estimate $40-60, no bid yet. Check top damage, leg joins, stability and whether the top is solid timber. Plain, large 167cm piece; value as decorative hall table is modest. Few eBay sales (2 rows over 3 years), prices from 2024.
